objective: Expose explicit externally owned decisions required before PQ-07 can start live effects or accept independently authenticated claims; classify absent or merely declared owners distinctly without self-certification.
nonGoals: Not a release-grant service, trust bootstrap, CI verifier, publication, target deploy or incident closer
No assumption that owner declarations authenticate their identities
No weakening baseline acceptance or target-project controls
decisions: Freeze eight operator-custody requirements before experiments; no silent default for signer, grant issuer, target or operator
Validate a bounded strictly canonical decision manifest against separately pinned manifest digest, scope and candidate identity
Only declaration coverage is reported; external authentication/approval never inferred even if every declaration present

obligations.description: Missing external trust/target/operations custody always visible and classified independently of source verification
Reject unknown, duplicate, malformed, wrong scope or forged approval claims

impact: New opt-in read-only package, no effect authority

budget.hostedRuns: one draft PR-stage run if triggered

externalEffects: Draft PR #48 stacked on #47; only PR #50 may integrate
No new credentials, target services, payments or publication
